To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the four dimensional discrete-time Lotka–Volterra model with self-inhibition terms for the prey species has a long persistence region under coexistence and that the existence of a flush-pursuer bird is explained as a result of the selective hunting strategy of the bird.

the four-dimensional discrete-time Lotka Volterra model can be modified to be more biologically realistic, and the model with modified parameters can be used to explain the existence of flushpursuer birds.

the Lotka-Volterrasystem with self-inhibition terms for preies can be used for modelling the ecosystem with a large number of species and that the system has the long persistence under co-existence if the predator specie who feeds on the relatively small number of the preys must be selective on available preys.

the study of a modified Lotka-Volterral model with self-inhibition for preys and its application to ecology.

a predator specy who feed on relatively large number of preys can be less selective on the available prey species, and that the ecosystem would be in danger when the predator specy becomes too greedy.
